quote: Metrics. To ensure a fair comparison, we adopt same metrics employed by SelfCheckGPT. The Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUC-PR) is used to measure the performance of sentence-level hallucination detection, while the Pearson and Spearman's correlation coefficient are applied to evaluate the agreement between the passage-level hallucination score and human judgement.
